question_stem: Particle $P$ of mass $m$ kg and particle $Q$ of mass $2$ kg are free to move on a smooth horizontal plane. $P$ and $Q$ are moving directly towards each other with speeds $u \text{ m s}^{-1}$ and $3u \text{ m s}^{-1}$ respectively. $P$ and $Q$ collide and the direction of motion of each particle is reversed by the collision. Immediately after the collision the speed of $P$ is $\frac{u}{3} \text{ m s}^{-1}$.
context_texts: $v_Q=\frac23mu-3u$ and $m>4.5$; $P$ moves at speed $u/3$ after the collision.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: Find, in terms of $m$ and $u$, an expression for the velocity of $Q$ after the collision and hence show that $m > 4.5$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: $Q$ subsequently hits a vertical wall which is perpendicular to the direction of motion of $Q$. The speed of $Q$ after the impact with the wall is a quarter of its speed before the impact with the wall. There are no further collisions between $P$ and $Q$.
parts.question_text: Given that $m$ is an integer, determine the largest possible value of $m$.
